segments.text: Thank you for visiting Ashaeiynn.com . We strive to provide you with the best products and services to enhance your spiritual journey. However, we would like to inform you about our No Refund Policy to ensure transparency and clarity regarding our services.

Once you book an aura checking session with us, it indicates your understanding and acceptance of our No Refund Policy. We dedicate our time, expertise, and resources to conduct thorough aura checks and provide you with valuable insights and recommendations. As such, refunds for aura checking sessions will not be provided under any circumstances.

If you decide to join Ashaeiynn as a member or participate in our spiritual growth programs, please note that the fees paid are non-refundable. We are committed to guiding you through the various stages of spirituality and providing you with the tools and knowledge to enhance your spiritual growth. Therefore, refunds for membership fees or program fees will not be granted.

In some instances, we may offer digital products, such as e-books or audio recordings, for purchase on our website. Once the digital product is purchased and delivered to you, it is deemed non-refundable. We ensure that our digital products are of high quality and provide value to our customers.

If you opt for personalized consultations or coaching sessions with our experts, please be aware that the fees paid for these services are non-refundable. We invest time, effort, and expertise in providing you with tailored guidance and support on your spiritual path.

We encourage you to carefully consider your purchase decision before making any payments on Ashaeiynn.com. If you have any questions or concerns about our services, please reach out to our customer support team for clarification before proceeding with a purchase.

Please note that this No Refund Policy applies to all services and products offered on Ashaeiynn.com unless stated otherwise. By using our website and engaging in any transactions with us, you acknowledge and agree to abide by this policy.
Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
